homePage.heroTagline: Bois la potion. Interprète le rôle. Gravis les Séquences de 9 vers la divinité, avant que la Brume ne te réclame.
homePage.circleTitle: Tous les pouvoirs du roman. Jouables.
homePage.circleLede: Notre plugin personnalisé implémente tout le système de pouvoirs Beyonder : 22 Voies, potions, rituels, Interprétation et perte de contrôle. Aucun mod requis ; un compagnon côté client ajoute les effets visuels.
homePage.circleStepOneBody: Pille des coffres qui se remplissent, échange avec des joueurs ou chasse des créatures mystiques afin d’obtenir une formule de potion de Séquence 9 de l’une des 22 Voies.
homePage.circleStepTwoBody: Réunis les ingrédients principaux, utilise le chaudron et avale ton destin. De vraies capacités, un coût en spiritualité et une vraie folie si tu te précipites.
homePage.circleStepThreeBody: Digère la potion en vivant le rôle de ta Séquence. Accomplis des rituels, progresse en Interprétation et gravis les Séquences de 9 → 0 au cours d’une saison.
homePage.observatoryLede: Recensement en direct de chaque joueur éveillé cette saison : les Voies qu’ils parcourent et jusqu’où ils se sont élevés. Mis à jour chaque heure depuis le serveur.
homePage.observatoryRegistryCta: Les sièges des Séquences 3–0 sont limités : consulter le Registre des Ascensions
homePage.newsEyebrow: Depuis l’autre côté de la Brume
homePage.closingLede: Rejoins-nous gratuitement. Avec Java 26.1.2+, accepte le pack de ressources : ta première Séquence n’est plus qu’à une soirée.

companion.title: COI Client
companion.lede: Mysterria fonctionne parfaitement avec un client Minecraft classique : chaque mécanique Beyonder se trouve sur le serveur. Le Client COI est un petit mod facultatif qui ajoute la seule chose qu’un client vanilla ne peut afficher : la magie elle-même.
companion.featureHotkeysBody: Associe tes capacités à des raccourcis et lance-les en plein combat sans jamais ouvrir de menu.
companion.featureVisualsBody: Cercles rituels, sigils et effets de lancement entièrement rendus sur ton propre client.
companion.featurePresenceBody: Une ambiance sonore propre au serveur, ainsi qu’une riche présence Discord affichant ta Séquence.
companion.platformNote: Dernière version · s’installe aux côtés du pack de ressources du serveur
companion.optional: Rien sur le serveur n’est verrouillé derrière le mod et il ne te sera jamais demandé de l’installer. Choisis simplement la plateforme que tu utilises déjà : les trois proposent la même version.

terms.title: Commission du système magique
terms.whatIsIt: Un service de développement sur mesure qui permet aux pratiquants de la magie de demander des ajustements ciblés et fidèles au lore sur des sorts, mécaniques ou capacités existants – évalués par nos testeurs et développeurs, puis implémentés directement par notre équipe technique.
requestOptions: Un budget commun de 6 points par demande – une modification majeure coûte 3 points, une modification mineure 1.
Jusqu’à 2 modifications majeures – une réécriture complète pour l’alignement sur le lore, une refonte d’équilibrage d’une capacité, ou l’ajout d’un nouveau sort ou d’une mise à l’échelle.

Jusqu’à 6 modifications mineures – petits ajustements de valeurs (temps de recharge, dégâts, coût en mana, constantes de mise à l’échelle) ou légères retouches de lore, sur un ou plusieurs sorts ou capacités.
Combine-les librement dans la limite du budget – p. ex. 1 majeure + 3 mineures consomment les 6 points, tout comme 2 majeures ou 6 mineures seules.
requirements: Justifiée – explique le raisonnement de jeu ou de lore qui la motive.
Fidèle au lore – ancrée dans l’univers établi ou le matériau source, pas inventée de toutes pièces.
Non fondamentale – aucune refonte des systèmes centraux ni modification de l’architecture.

Respectueuse du travail récent – ne demande pas de refaire un sort ou une capacité retravaillé récemment et actuellement bien équilibré, juste pour une autre interprétation. Si depuis il est réellement déséquilibré, obsolète ou défectueux – peu importe qui y a touché en dernier – tu peux légitimement en faire la demande.
howItWorksSteps: Les testeurs et développeurs évaluent sa faisabilité et sa fidélité au lore (vérification du staff).
Les demandes approuvées sont planifiées et implémentées.
Tu reçois une notification quand elle est disponible.
terms.note: Les demandes qui dépassent ce cadre seront réparties sur plusieurs commissions – nous te dirons exactement combien avant tout paiement supplémentaire.

hero.eyebrow: Lord of the Mysteries · Minecraft MMORPG
hero.lede: Mysterria turns Lord of the Mysteries into a Minecraft MMORPG. Choose one of 22 Beyonder Pathways, brew its potions, act out its role and climb from Sequence 9 toward godhood.
hero.fanLabel: The deck of 22 Pathways. Pick a face-down card to draw it.
hero.hint: Pick any face-down card, or shuffle the deck. The page becomes your Pathway.

ip.label: Server
ip.failedHelp: Your browser blocked the clipboard. Select the address above and copy it by hand.

reading.story: You drew the {name} card. On Mysterria your climb begins at Sequence 9 as a {role}, and runs {count} Sequences up to the throne at Sequence 0, with {abilities} abilities to earn along the way.
reading.storyBoon: You drew {name}, one of the 10 Boons: a supplementary path beside the 22. It begins at Sequence 9 as a {role} and stops at Sequence 5, with {abilities} abilities across its {count} Sequences.

past.lede: Mysterria is a Minecraft server that turns Lord of the Mysteries into a seasonal MMORPG. Potions, Sequences, acting, rituals, Madness: the whole Beyonder system runs on our own server plugin, so a plain Java client is all you need.
past.factSeason: A fresh world, about every six months
past.factEdition: Bedrock can join too, with limits
past.turn: Turn the card: the novel on one side, the server on the other
past.novelAlt: Fan art of Klein Moretti seated on his throne above the grey fog
past.gameAlt: A giant eye above a Rift on the Mysterria server

present.lede: There are no XP bars. Every Sequence is a potion. To become a {role} you find its formula, gather what it needs, brew it and drink it. Then you live the role until it settles.

formula.title: Find the formula
formula.body: Loot chests, trade with players or hunt Beyonder creatures for the {role} potion formula.

ingredients.title: Gather ingredients
ingredients.body: Main and supplementary ingredients come from chests, creatures, resource nodes and trades.

cauldron.title: Brew in the cauldron
cauldron.body: Build a Magic Cauldron from an Altar Scroll blueprint. A failed brew keeps your ingredients.

drink.title: Drink the potion
drink.body: Swallow it and you are a Beyonder. Your first potion needs no acting and no ritual.

act.title: Act & digest
act.body: Each ability has its own acting method. Combine acting, bounties, dungeons and Incursions to digest.

ritual.title: Perform the ritual
ritual.body: Optional for Sequences 8–6, though skipping adds Madness. Mandatory from Sequence 5 up.

present.guiAlt: The in-game Magic Cauldron interface with recipe, ingredient and confirm slots
present.guiBody: The recipe goes in the middle, main ingredients (or Beyonder Chars) on the left, supplementary ones on the right. Better cauldrons raise your odds of success.
present.madnessTitle: Rush it, and the potion drinks you.
present.madnessBody: Advancing unsafely, skipping rituals and dying all build Madness. Some of it fades with rest, some never does, and high Madness has real effects that can end in Mutation.

forces.lede: Between potions, this is where you spend your nights: dungeons behind Rifts, bosses that need a party, a moon that turns red, and towns that grow into nations.

rifts.title: Rifts & dungeons
rifts.body: Run /subspace to see every dungeon, its Rift, your relative power and cooldowns. Weaken a Rift with Energy Shards, form a party and go in for repeatable loot and acting.
rifts.alt: A huge eye glowing above a dungeon Rift

guardians.title: Guardians
guardians.body: Open-world bosses that protect key objectives. Built for groups, so bring friends.
guardians.alt: Players fighting a Guardian dragon inside a temple

moon.title: The Crimson Moon
moon.body: Beyonder creatures roam, and under the red moon fishing turns into a rich but risky loot run.

churches.title: Churches
churches.body: Player-run faiths built on a Church Core: prayer, anchors, land and perks.
churches.alt: A great cathedral rising through the clouds

towns.title: Claim your land
towns.body: Join a town for protected claims and shared cauldrons. Level it up, and Domain-level towns can found Nations.
towns.alt: A player-built town street with market stalls

emporium.title: The Brilliant Emporium
emporium.body: Coppets, Licks and Verl d'or. Trade surplus ingredients for Energy Shards, and spend Emporium points on its rotating stock.

deck.lede: Every card leads to its full Pathway page: each Sequence, every ability. Or make any one of them your card and watch the page change.
deck.boonsBody: Supplementary paths beside the 22. They start at Sequence 9 and stop at Sequence 5.

future.lede: The deck has spoken. A {role} is a free download and about an evening away. Here is how you sit down at the table.
future.step2Title: Launch Java and accept the pack
future.step2Body: Use a current Java client (26.1.2 or newer) and accept the server resource pack when Minecraft asks. Bedrock can join through Geyser, but some custom screens look wrong.
future.step3Body: Pick Mysteries in the lobby, then verify through your website profile. Ask in chat or on Discord for a town that takes newcomers.
future.newsFallbackBody: A fresh world and a full reset of Beyonder progress: everyone starts at Sequence 9 again. Read the announcement.

hero.eyebrow: A Lord of the Mysteries Minecraft server
hero.lede: Mysterria turns the web novel Lord of the Mysteries into a playable MMORPG. Choose one of 22 Beyonder Pathways, brew your first potion at Sequence 9 and climb, rung by rung, toward Sequence 0 - before the madness climbs faster.
hero.latestFallback: Season II has begun - read the news

paths.lede: 22 Beyonder Pathways, each a ladder of ten Sequences from a mortal at 9 to a god at 0. Your pathway isn't picked from a menu - it is whichever Sequence 9 potion you drink first.
paths.ladderLabel: {name} pathway - from {first} at Sequence 9 to {last} at Sequence 0
paths.boonsBody: A second, separate track advanced at Sacrificial Altars. Boons add to your pathway - they never replace it.

brew.title: Brew your way in.
brew.lede: There is no XP bar to grind. You become a Beyonder the way the novel says you do: find the formula, gather what it asks for, brew it, and drink.
brew.s1Body: Recipes turn up in naturally generated chests that refill over time, drop from Beyonder creatures, or change hands between players.
brew.s2Body: Some are found in loot chests, some drop from creatures, some grow as glowing nodes you harvest in the world.
brew.s3Body: Build it from an Altar Scroll. Mains left, supplementaries right, recipe in the centre. A failed brew costs you nothing.
brew.s4Body: A potion lasts two real-time days. Drink it, and you are a Sequence 9 Beyonder.
brew.starter: New here? Path of Resolve guarantees a recipe in your next chest. Path of Shortcut skips the brew - for 10% of your Spirituality, forever.
brew.sceneLabel: A Magic Cauldron brewing a Sequence 9 potion: three ingredients and a recipe go in, the potion rises out.

act.title: Become what you drank.
act.lede: A potion is digested, not ground out. Every ability has its own acting method - play the role and the action bar tells you it landed. Then the ritual decides whether you rise clean, or carry the cost.
act.meterNote: Combine several sources to reach 100%. Check your digestion, Spirituality and Madness from the pathway icon in your inventory.
act.ritualBody: Advancing to Sequence 8, 7 or 6, the ritual is optional. From Sequence 5 on, it is mandatory.
act.madnessBody: Rest and some mechanics ease the recoverable part. Death and unsafe advancement always add a little.
act.madnessSkip: Skipping adds permanent Madness for the whole season. High Madness has real effects - and can end in Mutation.

rift.lede: Dungeons wait behind Rifts scattered across the world. They are instanced, built for groups, and the richest repeatable source of materials and acting.
rift.s1Body: Every dungeon, its Rift location, your relative power and your cooldowns - in one menu.
rift.s2Body: Walk to it and feed it shards until it can be entered. Distance matters: there are no teleport commands.
rift.s3Body: Form your group and dive. Low-manning is allowed, with no cut to the rewards.
rift.f1Label: Real loot once per dungeon in that window
rift.f2Label: Help Card runs to carry newer players
rift.imgEye: The Eye Rift: a vast dungeon gate with a glowing eye above a swirling portal
rift.imgSnow: A ring-shaped Rift standing in a snowfield
rift.imgDungeon: Inside an instanced dungeon: crystals orbiting a glowing core

crimson.title: Now the world fights back.
crimson.lede: Past the line of demigods, Mysterria stops being a garden. Guardians hold the important ground, Wild Beyonders roam, and roughly once a week the moon turns red.
crimson.guardianBody: Open-world bosses protecting key objectives - designed for groups, not lone heroes.
crimson.moonBody: Beyonder creatures surge, and fishing turns into a rich, dangerous second loot stream.
crimson.wildBody: Their mood depends on how your pathways relate. Peaceful ones offer the best targeted trades in the game; hostile ones are serious fights.
crimson.imgDragon: Players fighting a Guardian dragon inside a great hall
crimson.imgRadiant: A party facing a radiant Guardian amid beams of light

dom.title: Build something that outlasts you.
dom.lede: Near the top, power turns into institutions. Players found Churches, raise towns into Domains and Domains into Nations, and run the economy everyone below depends on.
dom.churchBody: Player-run faiths built around a Church Core, anchors, prayer and land - with perks for the faithful and Honorific Names that grow shorter as their owner rises.
dom.landBody: Claim protected land, level your town for population and perks, then unite Domain-level towns into a Nation. Wars exist - and they are opt-in.
dom.wealthBody: Three currencies in your /wallet, Energy Shards for trades and Rifts, and the Brilliant Emporium rotating rare goods - recipes included.
dom.imgChurch: A player-built cathedral tower rising into storm clouds
dom.imgTown: The town square of Agora at dusk
dom.imgEmporium: The Brilliant Emporium, a glass-roofed market hall

summit.lede: Above the demigods the seats run out. Each pathway holds at most 18 Saints, 9 Angels, 3 Archangels - and a single god. Holding a pathway's Uniqueness is part of the road to Sequence 0.
summit.seatsLabel: High seats, per pathway, per season
summit.seatsNote: Every seat empties when the season resets - and every god on the Registry started at Sequence 9.
summit.seatsHeld: {n} of {total} high seats are held this season. Every one of those Beyonders started at Sequence 9.

join.s1Body: Multiplayer → Add Server → mc.mysterria.net. Java 26.1.2 or newer is the full experience; Bedrock joins through Geyser with some custom interfaces limited.
join.s2Body: It draws pathways, potions and interfaces - no mods required. Then choose Mysteries in the lobby.
join.s3Body: Resolve: a recipe guaranteed in your next chest. Shortcut: instant Sequence 9, at a permanent cost. Choose carefully - it can't be repicked.
join.s4Body: Recipe, cauldron, ingredients. Your first Sequence is about an evening away.
join.discordNote: Find a town, a party, or a hand with your first brew.

hero.kicker: Minecraft server · Java & Bedrock · Free to play
hero.sub: Choose one of 22 Beyonder Pathways, brew your first potion and climb from Sequence 9 toward godhood. It all happens in a shared seasonal world of Rifts, Guardians, Churches and Nations.

features.label: What you do here
features.title: An MMORPG, built inside Minecraft.
features.lede: Mysterria turns the Beyonder system of Lord of the Mysteries into a survival MMORPG. You don't grind XP for power. You earn it with potions, roles and rituals, and with the people you play alongside.

pathway.title: Choose a Pathway
pathway.body: 22 Beyonder Pathways from the novel, each with its own powers and ten Sequences to climb.

brew.title: Brew & drink the potion
brew.body: Find a formula, gather its ingredients and brew it in a Magic Cauldron. Drink it to become a Beyonder.
brew.alt: An in-game brewery with potion shelves and a cauldron over a fire

act.title: Act the role, perform the ritual
act.body: Digest each potion by living your Sequence's role, then perform the ritual that opens the next one.
act.alt: The candlelit nave of a player-built cathedral

fight.title: Fight in Rifts and against Guardians
fight.body: Party up for instanced dungeons through /subspace, and bring a group to open-world Guardian bosses.
fight.alt: Players fighting a dragon Guardian inside a sandstone temple

build.title: Build towns, Nations and Churches
build.body: Claim land, grow a town into a Domain, form a Nation, or found a Church around its Core.
build.alt: A player-built town square with timbered houses

trade.title: Trade in the Emporium
trade.body: Coppets, Licks and Verl d'or, Wild Beyonder trades and the rotating Brilliant Emporium.

pathways.label: 22 Beyonder Pathways
pathways.title: Pick the power you'll spend a season becoming.
pathways.lede: Every Pathway is a ladder of ten Sequences, from a Sequence 9 apprentice role to a Sequence 0 god. Hover over a sigil to preview its ladder, or open one to see every ability.
pathways.boonsBody: A separate progression track, advanced at Sacrificial Altars. A Boon runs alongside your Pathway and never replaces it.

progress.label: How progression works
progress.title: No XP bar. You drink your way up.
progress.lede: Each Sequence is a potion. Find its formula, brew it and drink it, then live the role until the potion is digested. Early Sequences take about a week. The highest take months.
progress.interfaceAlt: The Magic Cauldron brewing interface in-game

recipe.title: Find the formula
recipe.body: Loot refilling chests, trade, or hunt Beyonder creatures for a recipe. Focus a chest category to guarantee one.

gather.title: Gather ingredients
gather.body: Main and supplementary ingredients come from loot chests, Beyonder creatures and world nodes.

brew.title: Brew in the Cauldron
brew.body: Build a Magic Cauldron from an Altar Scroll and slot everything in order. A failed brew keeps your ingredients.

drink.title: Drink the potion
drink.body: You're a Sequence 9 Beyonder with real abilities. Drink it within two days, before it seals into an artifact.

act.title: Act the role
act.body: Each ability has its own acting method. Dungeons, bounties and Incursions also count toward digestion.

ritual.title: Ritual, then climb
ritual.body: From Sequence 8, a ritual opens the way, and from Sequence 5 it's mandatory. Then you brew again.

progress.ladderNote: Ten rungs per Pathway. The top seats are limited.
progress.madnessTitle: Rush it and the potion fights back.
progress.madnessBody: Deaths and unsafe advancement build Madness, and Madness left unchecked means losing control.

world.label: The world
world.title: A world that's really there.
world.lede: Season II runs on a bounded overworld built for Beyonders. There are Rifts to clear, Guardians to topple, a moon that turns red, and cities run entirely by players.

rifts.title: Instanced dungeons behind every Rift
rifts.body: /subspace lists every dungeon, its Rift and your relative power. Weaken the Rift with Energy Shards, form a party and go in. Each dungeon gives real loot once every three days.
rifts.alt: A stone ring Rift standing in a snowfield

churches.title: Faith you can build
churches.body: Churches are late-game institutions. Anchor a Church Core, gather prayer, hold land and unlock perks for the faithful.
churches.alt: A towering player-built cathedral under storm clouds

moon.title: Some nights, the moon turns red
moon.body: Roughly once a week, Beyonder creatures prowl and fishing becomes a rich but dangerous loot stream.

guardians.title: Open-world bosses built for groups
guardians.body: Guardians protect important objectives. Bring a party, and bring a plan.
guardians.alt: Players battling a radiant Guardian beneath shafts of light

nations.title: Cities run by players
nations.body: Towns claim land and level up into Domains. Domains can band together into Nations and wage structured, opt-in wars.
nations.alt: A player-built castle town lit up at night

safety.label: No wilderness PvP, and griefing is banned

loot.label: Every generated chest is renewable Beyonder loot

season.label: A fresh start, so joining mid-season still pays off

live.label: On air
live.title: Season II, live right now.
live.seatsLede: The highest Sequences are capped per Pathway. Once a seat is taken, someone has to give it up first.
live.newsFallbackBody: The world and every Beyonder have reset. Read what changed for the new season, then claim your Sequence 9 before the high seats fill.
live.newsFallbackAlt: A Beyonder flying beside a blocky planet in space

community.label: Community
community.title: Find your party before you log in.
community.lede: Town recruiting, dungeon groups, trades and lore arguments all happen on Discord. The wiki and live map cover the rest.

discord.title: Discord
discord.body: Announcements, town recruiting, party finder and support tickets.

wiki.title: Wiki
wiki.body: Every Pathway, item, creature and system, written up by the community.

map.title: Live map
map.body: See towns, Nations and the world border in real time.

join.label: Join tonight
join.title: Your first Sequence is about an evening away.

steps.lobby: Choose Mysteries in the lobby selector

join.requirements: Java 26.1.2+ recommended. Bedrock joins through Geyser with some UI limits.
